label: Procrustes Methods and Shape Analysis
notes: Welcome to the chapter on shape. We will strip rotation, translation, and scale from landmark configurations until only geometry remains. The orthogonal Procrustes problem supplies the rotation step, and its singular value decomposition solution threads every construction that follows, from generalized alignment to Kendall's shape space.

label: Landmark Configurations
notes: A configuration is a matrix of labelled landmark coordinates. Two such matrices describe the same shape when one becomes the other after rotation, translation, and rescaling. Our task is to quotient out exactly those three nuisance transformations so that the residual difference measures genuine shape, not pose or size.

label: The Orthogonal Procrustes Problem
notes: Here is the central optimization. Holding both configurations fixed, we seek the orthogonal matrix that rotates B onto A with least squared error. Because the rotation is constrained to the orthogonal group, this is a constrained least squares problem whose closed form solution is the payoff of the next slide.

label: SVD Solution
notes: Expand the Frobenius objective; the only term that depends on the rotation is the trace of Q transpose times B transpose A. Maximizing that trace over orthogonal matrices is solved by the singular value decomposition of B transpose A. The optimal rotation is simply U times V transpose, a remarkably clean result.

label: Removing Translation
notes: Translation is removed first because it decouples cleanly from rotation and scale. Centering each configuration at its centroid, equivalently multiplying by the centering matrix, sends both clouds to a common origin. After centering, the optimal translation is automatically zero, so the remaining work concerns only rotation and scale.

label: Removing Scale
notes: With configurations centered, size is captured by the centroid size, the Frobenius norm of the centered matrix. Dividing by centroid size places every configuration on the unit pre-shape sphere. Scale is now normalized, and only rotation separates two pre-shapes, which is exactly the orthogonal Procrustes problem we already solved.

label: Ordinary Procrustes Analysis
notes: Ordinary Procrustes analysis aligns one configuration onto a fixed target by composing the three steps: center, scale, then rotate by the singular value decomposition. The optimal scaling factor is the ratio of the relevant singular value sum to the squared norm. The result is the best matched copy and its residual.

label: Generalized Procrustes Analysis
notes: When many configurations must be aligned simultaneously, no single target is privileged. Generalized Procrustes analysis iterates: align every configuration to the current mean, recompute the mean, and repeat until the mean stabilizes. This alternating scheme decreases the total residual sum of squares monotonically and converges to a consensus shape.

label: The Pre-Shape Sphere
notes: Centering removes translation and leaves a subspace; normalizing by centroid size lands us on a sphere within that subspace, the pre-shape sphere. Points still differ by rotation, so shape is the quotient of this sphere by the rotation group. The fibers of that quotient are the rotation orbits.

label: Kendall's Shape Space
notes: Kendall's shape space is the pre-shape sphere modulo rotation. Each shape is an orbit, a whole circle or higher dimensional fiber of rotated pre-shapes collapsed to one point. This quotient carries a natural Riemannian metric, making shape space a curved manifold rather than a flat Euclidean parameter set.

label: Procrustes Distance
notes: Procrustes distance measures the geodesic separation of two shapes on Kendall's space. Operationally it is the angle between optimally aligned pre-shapes, computed from the singular values of the cross product matrix. Full Procrustes distance uses optimal scaling; partial Procrustes uses fixed unit size. Both quantify residual shape difference after alignment.

label: Synthesis and Outlook
notes: We assembled a pipeline: landmarks, remove translation, remove scale, remove rotation by singular value decomposition, then read distance on Kendall's space. The same trace maximization recurs at every stage. Next steps include tangent space statistics, Frechet means of shapes, and asymptotic tests that live on this curved manifold.
